acceptanceCriteria: Dogfood make targets refuse with a named error when BASE is not given, with a test.
body: Found 2026-10-18 by the lane-hygiene lane (PR beamfall/corvint#1107, head b04b5b61d, ASD-V0-013..018). Expected: dogfood targets refuse a missing BASE (local main may be the stale pre-snapshot lineage, decision 0331). Actual: Makefile line 1 defaults BASE to main outside LANE=1.

completion.reason: Delivered on main c9ca8beff43d8f548b054d3b3d40e3054cecf816 via batch beamfall/corvint#1399 (lane #1389); CI green on that commit (runs 39571877340). Owner 2026-10-21: CI-checked work needs no local full-gate. Evidence file sha256 0ffb68830d1e623ed1e9fea4cc4b89e4689c25f50980a72144e93214afb32ae4.

title: Makefile `BASE ?= main` silently uses local main when BASE is omitted from dogfood targets
